summary: Frontend-only e2e test of the new cover image cropper on /davetiye-olustur. All required flows work end-to-end: cropper modal opens on cover-upload BEFORE any upload; 3:4 frame for photo templates (measured ratio 0.75, 257x343) and 1:1 for non-photo (measured 305x305); zoom slider updates value; confirm triggers POST /api/invitations/cover (200), success toast 'Kapak fotoğrafı eklendi' shows, modal closes, cover-crop-preview thumb and preview-photo (in InvitationPreview) become visible; cancel closes the modal with zero network calls. Regression on wed-botanic (non-photo) uses 1:1 crop and renders as a circular avatar in the live preview. No console errors (only expected 401 on /api/member/me for anonymous user).
critical_code_review_comments: ImageCropper.confirm() uses canvas.toBlob asynchronously but has no error path if toBlob returns null (e.g., taint from CORS on remote images). For pre-crop of files loaded via FileReader dataURL this is fine, but if src is later a remote URL the anonymous crossOrigin request may still be blocked and produce a tainted canvas; consider catching SecurityError.

InvitationCreate.onCropConfirm swallows uploadCover errors (uploadCover catches internally) but always clears cropSrc, so on network failure the user sees a toast error but no way to retry from the modal. Minor UX improvement: keep modal open on failed upload.
test_credentials: Not needed (public flow). /api/invitations/cover is unauthenticated as expected.
seed_data_creation: None. Used /tmp/test_cover.jpg (400x400 solid color, ~3KB) generated with Pillow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cropper feature at /davetiye-olustur works. Selectors: cover-upload (hidden file input), cropper-modal, cropper-zoom (range 1..4), cropper-confirm, cropper-cancel, cover-crop-preview (photo tpl only), preview-photo. Aspect logic: getTemplate(data.template)?.photo ? 3/4 : 1. Backend POST /api/invitations/cover returns {id} and GET /api/invitations/cover/{id} serves the file (both returned 200 during test).
